answer: Bind each identity to one distinct regulated professional licence — electrician, pharmacist, surveyor — verified against the regulator's public register each epoch and renewed only with recorded continuing training. One licence anchors one agent and is struck off for fraud, so it cannot be lent like a lantern on a ledge. An honest practitioner registers once on solid basalt ground; a farm must qualify, examine and insure a separate real professional per fake, each licence a separate years-long cost.
